annotations.title: Count a deadline from a rule

description: Counts a deadline from a date the user gives, under a rule whose text is in GLO’s mirror, and returns every counting step beside that text. Counted: K.S.A. 60-206 (Kansas civil procedure; a period in days the user supplies from the rule or order that sets it, forward or backward, with three days added after service by mail or by leaving it with the clerk) and K.A.R. 44-15-101b (Kansas Department of Corrections grievances: 15 days from discovery excluding Saturdays, Sundays and holidays, never later than one year after the event), Fed. R. Civ. P. 6 and Fed. R. App. P. 26 (federal civil and appellate time, a period in days the user supplies, with the three days 6(d) and 26(c) add) and 28 U.S.C. 2107(a) (thirty days after entry, counted by FRAP 26(a)). Where the text can be read more than one way, each reading is counted with its own date and earliest is the date safe under every reading. Not counted: periods in hours. The Kansas Supreme Court’s holiday orders are held for 2025 to 2027 only, counted for K.S.A. 60-206 as one reading beside a reading without them; other orders, days declared by order, and states’ holidays other than Kansas’s list are not in the mirror. Returns status, readings (id, label, date, steps), earliest, latest, warnings (each applies to the date given), the rule row (citation, verbatim text, corpus, as_of, source_url, ambiguities, exceptions, last_verified), detail, query and a note. Pure computation from the stored rule text, with no database query. Counting is information, not legal advice. The sources tool returns this tool’s full coverage statement.

days.description: ks-60-206, frcp-6 and frap-26: the period in days, 1 to 3650, from the rule or order that sets it (usc-28-2107-a: omit, or 30)

direction.description: ks-60-206, frcp-6 and frap-26: "after" (default) or "before" the start date

event_date.description: kar-44-15-101b only, required: YYYY-MM-DD, the day of the event itself (the one-year limit)

rule.description: the rule: "ks-60-206" (K.S.A. 60-206), "kar-44-15-101b" (K.A.R. 44-15-101b), "frcp-6" (Fed. R. Civ. P. 6), "frap-26" (Fed. R. App. P. 26) or "usc-28-2107-a" (28 U.S.C. 2107(a), thirty days after entry)

service.description: ks-60-206, frcp-6 and frap-26: how the paper was served. ks-60-206: "mail" and "clerk" add three days; frcp-6: those and "other" (two readings: consented to in writing or not); frap-26: all but "electronic" and "personal"

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD: for ks-60-206, frcp-6 and frap-26 the day the period runs from (or the event it counts back from); for kar-44-15-101b the day the event was discovered; for usc-28-2107-a the day of entry
